name: Asset Maintenance History
query:
SELECT
    history.name AS
        "History:Link/Facility Asset Maintenance History:150",

    history.asset AS
        "Asset:Link/Asset:150",

    asset.asset_name AS
        "Asset Name:Data:170",

    history.work_order AS
        "Work Order:Link/Facility Work Order:150",

    history.subject AS
        "Subject:Data:220",

    history.maintenance_request AS
        "Request:Link/Issue:140",

    history.work_order_type AS
        "Type:Data:90",

    history.category AS
        "Category:Link/Issue Type:130",

    history.priority AS
        "Priority:Link/Issue Priority:100",

    history.facility_location AS
        "Facility Location:Link/Facility Location:180",

    location.site AS
        "Site:Link/Site:120",

    location.building AS
        "Building:Link/Building:120",

    history.actual_start AS
        "Actual Start:Datetime:145",

    history.actual_end AS
        "Actual End:Datetime:145",

    history.downtime_hours AS
        "Downtime Hours:Float:110",

    history.labor_hours AS
        "Labor Hours:Float:100",

    history.material_cost AS
        "Material Cost:Currency:115",

    history.resolution_summary AS
        "Resolution Summary:Data:250",

    history.closed_by AS
        "Closed By:Link/User:150",

    history.closed_on AS
        "Closed On:Datetime:145"

FROM `tabFacility Asset Maintenance History` history

LEFT JOIN `tabAsset` asset
    ON asset.name = history.asset

LEFT JOIN `tabFacility Location` location
    ON location.name = history.facility_location

WHERE
    DATE(history.closed_on)
        BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s

    AND history.company = %(company)s

    AND (
        %(work_order_type)s = 'All'
        OR history.work_order_type = %(work_order_type)s
    )

    AND (
        %(priority)s = 'All'
        OR history.priority = %(priority)s
    )

ORDER BY
    history.closed_on DESC
